title: MHomes
description: A modern, high-performance GUI-based home system. Fully customizable, watermark-free, and built for modern Minecraft servers.
body:
✨ Key Features
Intuitive GUI Navigation: Manage, teleport to, and delete homes through a clean, lag-free interface.

100% Customizable: Every message and action can be customized.

Performance Optimized: Extremely lightweight code ensures zero impact on your server's TPS.

No Watermarks: We believe in your brand. There are no "Powered by" messages or hidden watermarks.

Unlimited Potential: Set different home limits based on your settings.

📜 Commands
/sethome <name> – Create a new home point.

/home – Open the GUI to view and teleport to your homes.

/delhome <name> – Remove a specific home point.

🌐 Connect with Us
Need help or looking for more high-quality plugins? Join our community!
